I have experienced this in the quality results of different people's activities. One such experience was at Navin Surekha Photo Studio in Vile Parle East, very near the railway station. I had to convert my 41-year-old VHS video cassette to digital format. I was not sure that it would be converted to digital, but when I met Mr. Ojas bhai, the owner of the said photo studio, he assured me of a good result. And after two weeks of eager anticipation, I got surprisingly good results. Previously, 20-30 years ago i had converted this video cassette to CD quality from another shop, but its quality was not satisfactory to me. Thank God! My good luck was waiting for me to give a blissful experience from this result.
Though some old, unclean, fungus-damaged video scenes were not at a satisfactory level, most of the video results were very good compared to 40-year-old recordings and better than CD quality.
